Max Bookings Per Member Per Day

fields.description: Bookings cancelled within this many hours of start time may incur the no-show penalty. Distinct from the self-service Cancellation Window (Hours) field above, which blocks the cancellation outright rather than penalizing it - despite this field's name, the value here is in hours, not minutes.
fields.label: No-Show Penalty Window (hours)

fields.label: Require Payment Before Booking Confirmation

fields.description: Master switch for accepting Paystack payments across Facility Booking, Membership, Tournament Registration, Training Session, and Equipment Issue/Return.
fields.label: Enable Paystack Payments

fields.description: Default income accounts to be used if not set elsewhere to book Facility Booking, Membership, Tournament Registration, Equipment Rental and Training Session charges.
fields.label: Income Account

fields.description: Default receivable accounts to be used to book Facility Booking, Membership, Tournament Registration, Equipment Rental and Training Session charges.
fields.label: Receivable Account

fields.description: The Appointment Type that triggers the trialist workflow
fields.label: Trial Appointment Type

fields.description: Flat one-off fee billed once a trialist is registered against a medically-cleared Patient (Trialist.create_registration_invoice). Billed via the Trial Registration Cashier page (or the Trialist form's "Create Registration Bill" button) - leave at 0 to disable trial-registration billing entirely.
fields.label: Trial Registration Fee

fields.description: Item Group under which the Trial Registration Fee item is created (see Trial Registration Item in the Item master). Leave empty to skip trial-registration billing entirely.
fields.label: Trial Registration Item Group

fields.description: Every trialist checked in under the Trial Appointment Type above gets one Lab Test per row here, auto-created the moment the nurse saves vitals (see healthcare_integration.route_trial_after_vitals()) - covered by the same consultation fee charged at check-in, never billed separately. The trialist moves to the Doctor Queue only once every test here is Completed (or a front-desk/nursing override sends them through early). Leave empty to skip the lab stage entirely - vitals will go straight to the Doctor Queue as before.
fields.label: Required Lab Tests
Required Lab Tests for Trial Medical Exam

fields.description: Accent color for the public guest booking pages (Sports Complex, Book a Facility, My Bookings, Booking Confirmation) - buttons, icons, badges, and highlights. Leave as the default to keep the original green.
fields.label: Theme Color
Booking Calendar (Google)
fields.description: Confirmed Facility Bookings are pushed here as Events - see Integrations > Google Calendar to authorize/configure the calendar itself first. Leave empty to turn off calendar sync entirely.
